About

Making Democracy Work
for Every Community

I'm a graduate student at Georgetown University studying how democratic institutions function and how policy gets implemented. Having grown up in Kentucky, I ask why some communities are left out of American democracy — and how we can make everyday systems work better for them.

My work sits at the intersection of democratic theory and practical governance: understanding not just what policies say on paper, but how they actually reach people on the ground.

"Some communities are left out of American democracy — and the work of changing that begins with understanding why."

— Cody Ares Baynori
